title: Ind-étale, pro-étale and weakly étale morphisms
statement:
Let $R$ and $B$ be commutative rings. A ring map $R\to B$ is *ind-étale* if, as an $R$-algebra, $B$ is a filtered colimit of finitely presented étale $R$-algebras, with the convention of [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. All indexing categories are small; filtered includes nonemptiness, as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

For $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$ associated to an ind-étale $R$-algebra $B$ is called *affine pro-étale*. A presentation $B=\varinjlim_\alpha B_\alpha$ gives its affine inverse-limit presentation $\operatorname{Spec}B=\varprojlim_\alpha\operatorname{Spec}B_\alpha$, with the canonical maps, as in [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra].

For an arbitrary scheme $X$, a *pro-étale affine over $X$* is an $X$-scheme $u:U\to X$ admitting a small nonempty cofiltered presentation $U=\varprojlim_{i\in I}U_i$ over $X$, where every $U_i$ is an affine scheme and $U_i\to X$ is étale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Here cofiltered means that $I^{\mathrm{op}}$ is filtered [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The transition maps are $X$-morphisms. The limit over $X$ means compatible $X$-morphisms $p_i:U\to U_i$ such that every compatible family of $X$-morphisms $T\to U_i$ factors through exactly one $X$-morphism $T\to U$. The word affine refers to the schemes $U_i$ themselves, not merely to the morphisms $U_i\to X$.

A scheme morphism $u:U\to X$ is *weakly étale* if $u$ and its diagonal $\Delta_u:U\to U\times_XU$ are flat [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism]. A ring map $R\to B$ is weakly étale when both $R\to B$ and the multiplication map $B\otimes_RB\to B$, $b\otimes b'\mapsto bb'$, are flat, as in [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra].

lean.note: The existing upstream module publicly exposes all clauses. proAffineEtale is MorphismProperty.pro.{u} (@Etale ⊓ .ofObjectProperty (IsAffine ·) ⊤), so its stages are absolutely affine and etale, indexed by a small nonempty cofiltered category, with compatible structure maps and an IsLimit cone. For a cofiltered category this ambient limit is equivalently a limit over the base. Algebra.IndEtale and RingHom.IndEtale give the filtered-colimit ring convention, and proAffineEtale_Spec_iff gives the affine specialization. Scheme WeaklyEtale and Algebra.WeaklyEtale are the recorded Mathlib definitions; RingHom.WeaklyEtale applies the latter to the algebra structure of a ring map. No new definition or theorem is introduced.
